title: Cardinal Billing Account State Amendatory Schedule: State Installment Charge
content:
**Schedule clause.** The installment charge on a Cardinal Billing Account installment invoice is figured on the state installment charge for the governing state of the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy the account bills. The state installment charge is $4.50 when the governing state of the auto policy is Kentucky, $6.00 when that state is Virginia or West Virginia, and the pay plan's installment fee when it is any other state.

| Governing state on the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy | State installment charge |
|---|---|
| Kentucky (KY) | $4.50 |
| Virginia (VA) | $6.00 |
| West Virginia (WV) | $6.00 |
| Ohio (OH) | The pay plan's installment fee |
| Indiana (IN) | The pay plan's installment fee |

**Notes.** The governing state is the state recorded on the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy as the garaging state whose law governs the policy. The Kentucky, Virginia and West Virginia figures hold on every pay plan.

**Hypothetical illustration.** On a plan whose installment fee is $2.00, a Kentucky policy's state installment charge is $4.50 and an Ohio policy's is $2.00.
